The '''''Freebird''''' was a [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] under the command of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gorrister]]. The shuttle was stationed on the [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']], which was the base of operations for the secret Imperial weapons project codenamed "[[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]]."

==History==
Stationed on the [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']] during the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing]] infection, the ''Freebird'' served as a haven for [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gorrister]] and other survivors of the incident. Trapped in the shuttle for ten weeks, Gorrister and his men, starving, were often forced to partake in [[cannibalism]] and to throw other survivors out of the shuttle to the hungry blackwing [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]] tearing at the hull.

After [[Jareth Sartoris]], an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]], infiltrated the ''Vector'' to disable the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] that had pulled his [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] into the Star Destroyer's hangar, the recoil from his use of a stationary [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter's]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] cannons caused the starfighter to crash into the ''Freebird''. He entered the ship for refuge, where he met Gorrister and the other survivors, who explained the full extent of the situation to him. Sartosis killed Gorrister by using his head as a battering ram to open the escape hatch.

The ''Freebird'' was the means of escape for the other survivors of the incident: [[Zahara Cody]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Trig Longo]]. Sartoris sacrificed himself to allow the others access to the shuttle. The shuttle was later sold to [[Black Hammer pirates]] in [[Gal'fian'deprisi]], [[Galantos]].
